_about: Australian Election Study national issue history, 1990–2025: the 18 charts in the Election issues chapter of the official 2025 trends monograph. Categories and printed shares are preserved without renormalisation; null means an actually blank cell, not zero.

source.title: Trends in Australian Political Opinion: Results from the Australian Election Study, 1987–2025
source.granularity: Published national aggregate percentages; no respondent-level microdata

cellSemantics.national: All-voters rows are selected strictly by col1 === ''. Response labels are col0 verbatim.
cellSemantics.datedRows: Only years actually present and non-empty in the official national chart rows. No years are inferred or forward-filled.
cellSemantics.null: The official cell is blank or null; this is missing, not a zero reading.
cellSemantics.zero: A published numeric zero remains 0 and is distinct from null.
cellSemantics.normalisation: None. ALP, Coalition and No difference (and all vote-importance categories) are retained as printed; no ALP+Coalition renormalisation.

series.title: Most important non-economic election issues
notes: In 1996–2025 estimates for health are for ‘Health and Medicare’. The source category label remains ‘Health’.
‘Refugees and asylum seekers’ was not included in 2007.
